testsuite.name: gspa.predictor.PipelineEmptyInputSpec

testcase.name: nucleotide tools still scan a genome without proteins while protein tools explicitly skip
missing protein executable remains unavailable rather than being called on empty input
zero gene-caller output does not suppress independent nucleotide tools
a new empty input cannot retain old claims or integration results
a rejected input also clears state from the previous genome
protein input still executes protein predictors and resets disabled integration state
requested integration records the new empty genome instead of silently returning
